Messages.Author: Claudio Falcao
Messages.Body:
Here goes another one of my newbie questions.

Are the multi-option action cards (?) only usable at one version at a
time.

For example: Keystone Kine is a bleed action, no matter which
discipline the vampire is using.
Lets say Mina Grotius is anarch and bleeds with Keystone Kine.
Does she bleed for 2 and gain a blood if successfull, or does she need
to state which of the disciplines is she using?

Mina Grotius
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls (group 3)
Capacity: 6
Disciplines: FOR NEC cel
Laibon: Whenever a vampire controlled by your predator or prey is
burned, Mina gains 3 blood. Once each action, she can burn 1 blood to
get +1 bleed.

Keystone Kine
Type: Action
Requires: anarch Celerity/Necromancy/Obfuscate
Requires an anarch.
[cel] and/or [nec] and/or [obf] (D) Bleed. If using [cel], he or she
gains 1 blood. If using [nec], the bleed is at +1 bleed. If using
[obf] and this actioin is successful, you may burn an ally controlled
by your prey whose cost is not greater than the bleed amount.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Claudio Falcao wrote:
> Here goes another one of my newbie questions.
>
> Are the multi-option action cards (?) only usable at one version at a
> time.

They're usable as card text indicates.

> For example: Keystone Kine is a bleed action, no matter which
> discipline the vampire is using.
> Lets say Mina Grotius is anarch and bleeds with Keystone Kine.
> Does she bleed for 2 and gain a blood if successfull, or does she need
> to state which of the disciplines is she using?

She needs to state which Discipline or set of Disciplines she is using.

She can KK at [cel], or at [nec], or at [cel] and [nec].

That's what the "[cel] and/or [nec] and/or [obf]" means (in contrast to the
other Anarch 3-way cards, which tend to offer only individual Discipline usages,
with no option to use combinations in the single card play).
